<module id="fsm">
    <description>Mealy FSM detection circuit that detects the sequence '10011'.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to be detected.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating whether the input matches the sequence.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">First digit detected (1).</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">Second digit detected (0).</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">Third digit detected (0).</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">Fourth digit detected (1).</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">Fifth digit detected (1), match achieved.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state">The current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state">The next state of the FSM.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST)>
            if (RST)
                current_state <= S0;
            else
                current_state <= next_state;
        </always>
        
        <always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                S0: begin
                    if (IN == 1)
                        next_state = S1;
                    else
                        next_state = S0;
                end
                
                S1: begin
                    if (IN == 0)
                        next_state = S2;
                    else
                        next_state = S0;
                end
                
                S2: begin
                    if (IN == 0)
                        next_state = S3;
                    else
                        next_state = S0;
                end
                
                S3: begin
                    if (IN == 1)
                        next_state = S4;
                    else
                        next_state = S0;
                end
                
                S4: begin
                    if (IN == 1)
                        next_state = S5;
                    else
                        next_state = S0;
                end
                
                default: next_state = S0;
            endcase
        end
        
        <assign MATCH = (current_state == S5 && IN == 1)? 1 : 0;
    </assign>
end
    
    <implementation>
        On every change in IN, positive edge of CLK or positive edge of RST, if RST is active,
        output signal MATCH is set to 0. Else, the next state of the FSM is determined based on the current state and input signal IN.
        
        In state S0, if IN is 1, transition to state S1, else stay in S0. In state S1, if IN is 0, transition to state S2, else go back to S0.
        Similarly, in state S2, if IN is 0, transition to state S3, else go back to S0. In state S3, if IN is 1, transition to state S4, else go back to S0.
        In state S4, if IN is 1, transition to state S5, else go back to S0.
        
        If the current state is S5 and IN is 1, set MATCH to 1, else set MATCH to 0.
    </implementation>
</module>
